title: Canonical-composite proper forget-supports compositor
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, p:W→X and f:X→S be proper maps, and E an object of D(W_et,A), with an explicit properness instance for p;f. In the canonical-composite case, the inverse of properRouteCompIso A p f (p;f) rfl followed by the canonical proper comparison for p;f equals the ordinary composition path obtained by first comparing p, then comparing f, and finally applying the ordinary direct-image compositor.

proof.text: Use the equality-case normalization of properRouteCompIso to replace its inverse component by the inverse of rightDerivedLowerShriekCompIso A p f; the identity comparison for the canonical composite contributes only an identity morphism.
Apply the raw canonical-composite forget-supports compositor calculation, identifying properness instances for p;f by proof irrelevance. This gives the displayed ordinary composition path.
